title: A Tale of Two Idempotents: Casselman-Shalika and Spherical Genericity
summary: We give a self-contained Hecke-algebraic derivation of the Casselman-Shalika formula and J.-S. Li's genericity criterion for irreducible spherical representations of unramified groups, without using the unramified principal series or intertwining operators. The argument centers on the spherical and sign idempotents $e_K$ and $e_{\mathrm{sgn}}$ of the Iwahori-Hecke algebra $\mathcal{H}$. Their left ideals $\mathcal{H}e_K=\mathcal{A}e_K$ and $\mathcal{H}e_{\mathrm{sgn}}=\mathcal{A}e_{\mathrm{sgn}}$ are free of rank one over the Bernstein subalgebra $\mathcal{A}$.
